summary.text: Alan Aversa, a No Labels Party candidate who described himself as a teacher with a physics and astronomy degree from the University of Arizona, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Arizona's 3rd District to Yassamin Ansari.
He has appeared on Arizona ballots under other party labels.

paragraphs.text: Aversa was born in Ashland, Oregon. According to his 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona in 2008, in physics and astronomy with minors in math and Italian.
He has worked as an educator, teaching physics and computer programming in classrooms and online, and in a 2023 survey he described himself as a middle school science teacher.

Aversa ran unopposed in the 2012 Republican primary for Arizona House of Representatives District 3, and in 2024 he advanced from the Green Party primary for Arizona's 3rd Congressional District with 29 votes.
In 2026 he was the No Labels Party nominee, having advanced from that party's primary on July 21, 2026. In earlier surveys he listed right to life as a priority.
He received 6.1% of the vote to Yassamin Ansari's 87.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
